story.iWant: to compare my performance across different roles side-by-side
story.soThat: I can easily identify which role I perform best in

tasks.task: Integrate role comparison into analytics dashboard (AC: #1, #2)
Add error handling and edge cases (AC: #4, #5)

criterion.given: I have performance data for multiple roles
criterion.then: - Side-by-side comparison table or cards showing metrics for each role: win rate, games played, average ELO, win streak - Comparison charts (bar chart comparing metrics across roles) - Highlighting of best-performing role (visual emphasis: color, badge) - Ability to select which metrics to compare - Smooth animations when data loads/updates

criterion.when: I apply date range or role filters
criterion.then: - Updates comparison data to reflect filtered results - Refreshes comparison table and charts - Maintains filter selection across updates - Shows active filters in comparison view
- Shows tooltips with detailed metric values - Displays role-specific information - Highlights related elements in charts
- Shows loading skeleton screens for comparison table - Displays loading indicators on charts - Maintains filter selections during loading

criterion.given: I have insufficient data for comparison (less than 2 roles with data)
criterion.then: - Displays helpful empty state message - Explains why comparison is unavailable - Suggests actions (import more data, adjust filters)

docs.doc: Defines role comparison requirements, data models (RoleComparison interface), API endpoint specification (GET /api/players/[id]/analytics/role-comparison), and acceptance criteria AC8.
Story 3.8 corresponds to Epic 4 Story 4.8. Defines role comparison as part of player analytics scope with FR23 coverage.

Clean Architecture + Hexagonal patterns. Components in Presentation Layer (src/components/analytics/), use cases in Application Layer, repositories in Infrastructure Layer. State management: TanStack Query for server state, Zustand for client state (filters).

Learnings: Zustand store pattern for filters, TanStack Query integration (5min stale, 10min GC), component structure in src/components/analytics/, filter integration via Zustand store, repository pattern, API parameter handling, type safety, testing patterns, chart library usage (Recharts).

Chart library: Recharts (^3.6.0) or Chart.js. Styling: Tailwind CSS 3.3.0 with tailwind-variants. Type safety: TypeScript 5.0.0 strict mode. Validation: Zod 4.1.12. Authentication: NextAuth.js session required for all analytics endpoints.

artifact.reason: Similar comparison component pattern - shows period comparison with metrics, badges, tooltips. Role comparison should follow similar structure.
Chart component using Recharts - role comparison charts should follow same pattern for bar charts comparing metrics across roles.
Zustand store for analytics filters - role comparison should read dateRange and roles from this store to ensure filter changes trigger data refetch.
TanStack Query hook pattern - role comparison hook should follow same pattern: 5min stale time, 10min GC time, include dateRange and roles in query key.
Repository pattern for analytics data - role comparison repository should follow same pattern: date range filtering, role filtering, indexed queries for performance.
Use case pattern for analytics - role comparison use case should orchestrate repository calls, calculate best-performing role, format response data.
API endpoint pattern - role comparison endpoint should follow same pattern: authenticateRequest, requireRole, Zod validation, error handling, query parameter processing.
TypeScript types for analytics - add RoleComparison, RoleComparisonMetrics types here following existing type patterns.
Zod validation schemas - add role comparison validation schemas following same pattern as trends endpoint.

constraints.constraint: Clean Architecture + Hexagonal: RoleComparison component in Presentation Layer (src/components/analytics/), use case in Application Layer (src/application/use-cases/), repository in Infrastructure Layer (src/infrastructure/persistence/)
API Routes: Follow established request/response format patterns in src/app/api/players/[id]/analytics/ - add role-comparison endpoint following same pattern as trends endpoint
State Management: Use TanStack Query for server state (comparison data), Zustand for client state (filters) - role comparison hook should use TanStack Query, read filters from Zustand store
Chart Library: Use Recharts for comparison visualizations - follow same patterns as TrendsChart component
Styling: Use Tailwind CSS 3.3.0 with tailwind-variants for component variants
Type Safety: TypeScript 5.0.0 with strict mode - maintain type safety throughout
Validation: Use Zod 4.1.12 for API request/response validation - add role comparison validation schemas
Authentication: All analytics endpoints require authentication via NextAuth.js session - role comparison endpoint should follow same auth pattern
Performance: API response time target < 500ms - use database indexes for date range and role filtering
Testing: Maintain minimum 80% test coverage - unit tests for repository/use case/hook, integration tests for API endpoint, component tests for components, E2E test for complete flow

interface.name: RoleComparison
interface.signature: interface RoleComparison { roles: RoleMetrics[]; bestPerformingRole: PlayerRole; metrics: { winRate: Record<string, number>; gamesPlayed: Record<string, number>; averageELO: Record<string, number>; winStreak: Record<string, number>; } }

interfaces.interface: Role comparison data structure with metrics per role and best-performing role identification.

interface.name: RoleComparisonMetrics
interface.signature: interface RoleComparisonMetrics { role: PlayerRole; winRate: number; gamesPlayed: number; averageELO: number; winStreak: number; }

interfaces.interface: Metrics for a single role in comparison view.

interface.name: useRoleComparison
interface.signature: function useRoleComparison(playerId: string, dateRange?: DateRange, roles?: PlayerRole[]): UseQueryResult<RoleComparison>

interfaces.interface: TanStack Query hook for fetching role comparison data. Includes dateRange and roles in query key for cache invalidation. 5min stale time, 10min GC time.

interface.name: RoleComparisonProps
interface.signature: interface RoleComparisonProps { playerId: string; dateRange?: DateRange; }

interfaces.interface: Props for RoleComparison component. Reads filters from Zustand store.

interface.name: RoleComparisonRepository
interface.signature: class RoleComparisonRepository { getRoleComparison(playerId: string, dateRange?: DateRange, roles?: PlayerRole[]): Promise<RawRoleComparisonData[]> }

interfaces.interface: Repository for querying role comparison data from database. Applies date range and role filtering, uses indexed columns for performance.

interface.name: GetRoleComparisonUseCase
interface.signature: class GetRoleComparisonUseCase { execute(playerId: string, dateRange?: DateRange, roles?: PlayerRole[]): Promise<RoleComparison> }

interfaces.interface: Use case orchestrates repository calls, calculates best-performing role (based on win rate and ELO), formats response data.

tests.standards: Test Coverage: Maintain minimum 80% test coverage for all new code. Unit Tests: Vitest 1.0.0 for repository logic, use cases, and hooks. Component Tests: React Testing Library for component rendering and interactions. Integration Tests: Test API endpoints with various date range and role filter parameters. E2E Tests: Playwright 1.56.1 for complete user flows. Performance Testing: Verify API response time < 500ms.
tests.locations: Unit tests: tests/unit/repositories/, tests/unit/use-cases/, tests/unit/hooks/ Integration tests: tests/integration/api/analytics/ Component tests: tests/components/analytics/ E2E tests: tests/e2e/analytics/

ideas.idea: Unit test: Role comparison repository aggregation logic - test win rate, games played, average ELO, win streak calculations per role with date range and role filtering
Unit test: Role comparison use case - test best-performing role calculation (based on win rate and ELO), response formatting
Unit test: Role comparison hook - test TanStack Query integration, query key includes dateRange and roles, cache invalidation
Component test: RoleComparison component - test comparison table/cards display, metric selection, best role highlighting, responsiveness
Component test: RoleComparisonChart component - test bar chart rendering, tooltips, best role highlighting in chart
Integration test: Role comparison API endpoint - test with various date range and role filter combinations, verify filtered results
Integration test: Filter integration - test filter changes trigger comparison data refetch, filter persistence across updates
Component test: Hover tooltips - test tooltip display on comparison elements, role-specific information, chart element highlighting
Component test: Loading states - test loading skeleton screens, loading indicators on charts, filter selection maintained during loading
Component test: Empty state - test empty state message when insufficient data (< 2 roles), helpful messaging, action suggestions
E2E test: Complete flow - view comparison → apply filters → select metrics → view charts → hover tooltips → verify best role highlighting
